subject: South Reservoir Dam Improvements
overview: The Conservation Commission reviewed and approved an order of conditions for the Town of Winchester's dam rehabilitation project at the South Reservoir, incorporating specific conditions for tree replacement and invasive species management. The commission also approved previous meeting minutes and discussed ongoing local conservation projects.

items.title: Notice of Intent: South Reservoir Dam Improvements (DEP #215-0235)
items.summary: Approved an Order of Conditions for dam improvements with special conditions including a 1-to-3 tree replication ratio, a pre-construction invasive species management plan, and an operations and maintenance plan for the bordering vegetated wetland buffer.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes for November 1 and November 15, 2023.

items.title: General Updates and Project Reports
items.summary: Staff briefed the commission on upcoming member recruitment and updates on the Clippership Connector and Condon Shell projects.
